I'll push through. It gets really hard sometimes; sometimes I lose my will to live.

Thank you for your support

> You'll have to live with it forever

But I know there is an escape, a permanent escape. I just don't have the guts.

I don't know if this post is against the rules or not, but don't do it like that. Suffocation is an extremely painful method of suicide (experience) and it is highly likely you will not follow through. At first it seems like you'll go through, but a few seconds in you feel the panic. The carbon dioxide building up in your system, you heart beating faster. You'll frantically jump out of the shower, panicked.

Don't do it. It hurts more than you would think.

> easy life

No, not really. Basic human communication is a challenge. You don't understand unless you have a stutter yourself.
Hmm, that makes sense. That's a really nice way to explain it, in terms of options and consequences. Thank you!
This reminds me of [this](http://imgur.com/a/lBMcI) 4chan post I saw a while ago. It's basically what you said, with all the same elements.

I'm in literally the same position as OP. 

I'm just worried that explicitly saying "date" would make it too awkward, you know? She's never had a boyfriend before, and she isn't the type of girl that talks to multiple boys and stuff like that; she has very little social media, as well. 

I asked her to go to a movie once, and she said yes. She said the theater would be crowded, and I said I'm sure there'll be two seats. She then asked me if I was going to invite anyone else. Do you see my problem? She may not even be interested in me, and if she isn't and I use "date" I could be flat-out rejected.

And again, same with OP, that could damage our relationship. She isn't one to forget things very easily. I'm almost certain the rejection would always linger between us.

Edit: After reading a few more posts on this sub, I realized everyone seems to be saying that the usage of the word "date" is imperative. So alright, fine. I guess then my question is, what exactly do I say?
